judgment_scope: Exhaustive entity judgments within catalog.json; omitted entities have grade 0. Grade 2 or 3 is relevant. These are curated regression fixtures, not representative production estimates.

queries.rationale: Single 30-pin base boards are preferred; the explicitly labeled bulk pack is relevant but a distinct purchase unit. 38-pin, S3 and enclosure listings do not satisfy the request.
The HTTP API exposes a vendor selector; only that vendor's offer can appear, even if another vendor sells the same entity. MCP does not advertise this selector.
S3 identity must be preserved.
Wireless Pico variant explicitly requested.
4GB and 8GB variants are not interchangeable; this is a single-board computer, not a microcontroller.
Explicit RAM variant of a single-board computer.
Sensor module; its protective case is not a sensor.
Identifier separator normalization preserves complete letter/number groups.
Exact component identity.
Out-of-stock products remain discoverable unless stock is required.
The only BME280 is out of stock; confirmed answer is empty.
CP2102 is a different bridge chip.
Exact USB UART chip identity.
AMS1117 is a different regulator topology and identifier.
The exact identifier is absent from the closed fixture catalog.
A nonexistent capacity must not be silently replaced by 4GB or 8GB.
Only the 12V 100RPM motor has all required sold-item evidence.
24V supply rating; missing voltage is unknown, not a match.
500RPM passes; availability is not required.
The only sufficiently fast motor is out of stock.
Motor bracket ratings describe a supported motor and must not qualify the bracket.
Capacity AND continuous current; cases, BMS and missing current do not confirm a battery pack.
Both complete 40Ah packs pass regardless of discharge current.
No complete battery has the required continuous current.
The 3.7V 2000mAh cell meets both constraints.
Resistance alone permits either package; an assortment kit is not confirmed evidence.
Value and package are both mandatory.
100nF is 0.1uF, not 100uF.
The 100uF capacitor is rated only 25V.
Two-channel and four-channel relays are different variants.
Numeric channel identity must survive ranking.
Both two-channel offers cost less than 70; the four-channel relay costs 75.
Explicit budget should agree with the query budget.
The 60 INR offer qualifies; the 65 INR offer for the same entity must still be excluded.
Absence of an encoder has no explicit supporting evidence in this catalog.

contracts.rationale: The MCP envelope must preserve unresolved runtime and must not claim it is verified.
Malformed filters must not be discarded.
Unknown filter is a client error, not a server error or a broad search.
HTTP parameter validation is exercised through ASGI.
Invalid page is rejected before execution.
Exercise registered MCP argument validation, not direct Python calls.
A nonpositive limit must not mean unlimited retrieval.
Fake live vendors return the frozen catalog; caller filters must still apply.
A refresh cannot leave an out-of-budget, out-of-stock listing in a confirmed page.
